finalText:
Perfect! All tests passing. The bug was in the `isExpired` function at token.js:7—it used `<` instead of `<=` for the expiration comparison. This allowed tokens expiring at the exact moment to slip through as valid.

**The fix:** Changed `token.exp < nowSeconds` to `token.exp <= nowSeconds` so tokens are properly marked as expired the moment their expiration time is reached, not just after.

All 5 tests are now passing ✓
